name: Lillian McKeldin
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Sister of Charles "Buckey" McKeldin, named in his daughter Barbara's memoir; died before she wrote. The family diva, per her niece Barbara. [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 392, 4153]
Lillian M., aged 9 in the 1920 census and 19 in 1930, at 1143 Carroll Street.
